user.title: Anker SOLIX S5000
user.description: Sign in with the Anker account that owns the S5000. Data and controls go through the Anker cloud and its MQTT server, so the device must be online.

data_description.email: The Anker app login of the device owner
data_description.country: Two-letter country code used in the Anker app (e.g. US, DE, ZA)

device.title: Select device
device.description: Several supported devices were found on this account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Anker cloud rejected the stored password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email, password and country.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Anker cloud. Try again later.
error.no_devices: No unconfigured Anker SOLIX S5000 (or S2000) was found on this account. The account must own the device, not just be a shared member.
